name: links
purpose: Arcs between the bodies in nodes, as thick as their weights in w. A matrix gives one arc for each pair. It shows who gives weight to whom, for example attention between words.
binds: w: a matrix, or a list of numbers; row: a number or a state key

nodes.doc: the ids of the bodies that the arcs join, in the order of the rows and columns of w

w.doc: the state key of a matrix (row i, column j is the weight from node i to node j), or of a list (the weights from node row)

row.doc: the index of one node, from 0: only its arcs show; a key lets the learner pick the node

min.doc: a weight below this has no arc

lift.doc: how high the arcs rise above the line of nodes, as a share of the span

width.doc: the thickness of the heaviest arc, in units of a thin line

show.doc: a state key; the arcs show when its value is true

step.doc: the arcs show from this step of the scene
